maddeler.e:
نتشيطن (form IIq)
# نَتَشَيْطَنُ (natašayṭanu) /na.ta.ʃaj.tˤa.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# نَتَشَيْطَنَ (natašayṭana) /na.ta.ʃaj.tˤa.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# نَتَشَيْطَنْ (natašayṭan) /na.ta.ʃaj.tˤan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
